label: token right after an early p (original phase, positions 2-4)
explanation: Fires during the original-input phase on the step right after the input p, when that step is at position 2-4 (so p was the 2nd-4th original token). prev_tok == p holds 95% of activation mass (29.5x lift). Strongest at t=3 (49% of mass), then t=2 (29%) and t=4 (20%). It is essentially silent at t=0-1 and t>=6 and on <DEL>/copy steps (no copy-phase activations at all), even when a copy-phase step follows a p. Magnitude is largest when the prefix before p is e/w/c followed by 0 (e.g. e 0 p _ hits the max) and when the current token appears for the first time. The current token itself matters little. Precision is incomplete: at t=4 most p-followers stay inactive (precision 0.43), apparently depending on the earlier prefix. Missed activations are weak (7% of mass), mostly small activations at steps 3-4 without a preceding p.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=2 & prev_tok=p (+11.41), t=1 & prev_tok=p (+9.25), prev_tok=p (+9.06), orig0=e (+6.04), orig_idx=3 (+5.18), orig0=c (+4.87). Lower it: orig0=p (-6.96), orig_idx=-1 (-5.33), orig0=r (-5.27), t=6 (-4.66).
